sections.heading: I build the *systems* that keep *institutions* running.
sections.body:
I lead institutional operations, strengthen management systems and coordinate complex projects, improving how organisations work through structured processes, careful use of resources and practical technology.

Building systems. Strengthening operations. Enabling growth.
sections.items:
View experience | #experience
Explore projects | #projects

sections.heading: How I drive *operational excellence*
sections.body: Five pillars of my work. As you scroll, the same points of light rebuild into each one.
sections.items:
Institutional Operations | Day-to-day administration, procedures and reporting that keep a multi-programme trust running | The institution stands on its columns; the gears are the daily routines that keep it running.
Procurement & Supply Chain | A written SOP covering every step from RFQ and comparative statement to purchase order and delivery | From the factory to the customer: made, stored, shipped and delivered, with every handover planned.
Project Coordination | The operations side of a seven-storey mosque and an eleven-storey academic building | Two buildings rising on one site, with engineers, contractors and suppliers kept moving together.
Digital Transformation | Income, expense, KPI, inventory and attendance systems, and planning for an ERP | Data flows from the server to a live dashboard, so decisions rest on current figures, not paper.
People & Organisational Development | A team of 8 to 10, with clear roles, staff training and HR policy | One lead, three teams, six members: clear roles and clear reporting lines.

sections.heading: Meet the *person* behind the *systems*
sections.body:
Assalamu alaikum,

I focus on building structured management systems, improving operational efficiency, strengthening teams, and turning organisational priorities into coordinated action and measurable outcomes.

Since November 2023 I have managed administration and operations at Imam Bukhari Trust, an educational and social-welfare institution in Dhaka. My engineering degree and my MBA in Supply Chain Management give me an analytical, systems-first way of working.

Building systems. Strengthening operations. Enabling growth.

Nov 2023 to present | Manager, Administration and Operations | Imam Bukhari Trust, Dhaka | I manage administration and operations for a multi-programme educational and social-welfare trust. I lead a team of 8 to 10 staff, report to the Management Committee, and work with scholars, contractors, suppliers, partner institutions and donors. | Strategic and institutional operations: run day-to-day administration and operations across the Trust's programmes, set up internal procedures and reporting structures, and turn Management Committee priorities into assigned, tracked work; sections.heading: Projects and *case studies*
sections.body: Five pieces of work from Imam Bukhari Trust, each set out as a short case study: the challenge, my role, what I did, the result and the evidence. Where a figure belongs to the institution rather than to me, the case says so.

sections.items:
Infrastructure | Imam Bukhari Jame Masjid Complex and academic building | Two large buildings are going up at the same time, with several contractors, engineers and suppliers involved, and the Management Committee needs one reliable picture of progress and spending. | I coordinate the project on the operations side and report to the Management Committee. The engineers and contractors run the construction itself, and the budget is approved by the committee. | Coordinate contractors, engineers and suppliers, follow up site work and material supply, track the timeline and costs, prepare progress updates for management, and arrange site services such as separate three-phase power connections for each building. | As of November 2026, the mosque's second floor is complete and work on the academic building's first floor is under way. Since piling began in 2024, management has had one consistent view of progress and spending. | Project coordination, Contractor management, Cost tracking, Stakeholder management, Risk management |  | The Trust is building the Imam Bukhari Jame Masjid Complex, a seven-storey mosque, alongside an eleven-storey academic building. | Site photos on this page. Progress reports and cost records are internal to the Trust.
Procurement | Procurement and supply chain system | Purchases and service contracts needed a written, repeatable procedure that the Management Committee could review and trust. | I wrote the procurement SOP and coordinate the purchasing cycle up to the committee's decision. | Set out the steps for RFQs, vendor evaluation, comparative statements, purchase orders, approvals and delivery follow-up, and introduced total-cost-of-ownership analysis for high-value purchases, including a three-firm comparison to select the external auditor. | Ad-hoc buying was replaced by a documented procedure. Purchases now reach the committee with a comparative statement behind them, as they did when the external auditor was selected in 2026. | Procurement management, Vendor evaluation, Total cost of ownership, Policy development, Financial compliance |  | A written procurement procedure for a growing trust, from the request for quotation to delivery. | The image is an illustration of the comparative statement format. The SOP and real statements stay internal.
Digital systems | Digital operations and management systems | Income, expenses, KPIs, stock, attendance and staff tasks sat in separate files and paper registers, and monthly reports were put together by hand. | I designed and built the systems, wrote the user guides, and lead the planning for an ERP. | Built the Trust's first digital income, expense, KPI and inventory systems; merged income and expense into one entry sheet with automatic monthly Receipts and Payments reports; added an attendance and leave system that follows the HR policy, a live task dashboard, a participant directory and a login-based data app for the programme team; and began planning an ERP covering finance, HR, procurement, inventory and donors. | Monthly Receipts and Payments reports are now produced automatically, each area is tracked in one place, and less data has to be entered twice. | Process design, Google Sheets and Apps Script, Dashboards, ERP planning, Change management |  | A set of Google Sheets and Apps Script systems that replaced separate files and paper registers. | The image is an illustration of the dashboard style. The live systems hold donor and staff data, so they are not shown.
Programmes | Programmes, training and events | Courses, workshops, special programmes and a weekly halaqa bring thousands of people together each year, in person and online, and every one needs a plan that staff and volunteers can follow. | I coordinate the operations behind them with programme managers, scholars, staff and volunteers, and design and deliver staff training. | Built plans and volunteer maps, assigned roles across IBT staff, partner institutions and volunteers, managed logistics on the day, and designed and delivered staff training on professional ethics, team building, and task, time and SMART planning. | Since November 2023 the Trust has held 140 programmes and sessions with 14,296 recorded attendances. These are institutional figures. My part is the planning, coordination and logistics behind them, including family get-togethers of 432 (2025) and 605 (2026) and a day-long dawah skills training. | Programme management, Event operations, Volunteer management, Training design and delivery |  | The Trust's courses, workshops, special programmes and weekly halaqa, run with staff, scholars, partner institutions and volunteers. | Programme photos on this page. Attendance figures come from the Trust's programme records.
Institutional development | Fundraising and institutional development | A growing trust needed steady donor income, clear governance and strong links with partner institutions. | I supervise fundraising and support the Management Committee on governance and planning. | Supervised fundraising campaigns and donor follow-up, recorded and acknowledged donations across mobile and bank channels, prepared committee reports, and worked on policy reform and the revision of the Trust's constitution. | The Trust has run 32 fundraising campaigns under my supervision, and 70 of the 90 units in its residential project have been sold. Committee decisions are backed by regular reports. | Fundraising, Donor relations, Governance and reporting, Policy development, Stakeholder engagement |  | Donor income, governance support and partnerships for a growing trust. | Photos of partner visits and an MoU signing on this page.

sections.heading: Professional profile
sections.body:
I am an operations and management professional with 4+ years of experience, an engineering background and an MBA in Supply Chain Management. My work spans institutional operations, administration, procurement and supply chain, project coordination, digital transformation, financial monitoring and organisational development.

As Manager, Administration and Operations at Imam Bukhari Trust, I work across these functions to make operations more efficient, improve internal processes and support the Management Committee in carrying out its plans. I lead a team of 8 to 10 and report to the Management Committee.

The roles I am looking for next are in operations, administration and operations, project and operations, and supply chain and procurement management. Over the longer term I want to lead operations as a head of operations or operations director. Alongside this, I co-author research on Islamic education and keep studying the Islamic sciences and Arabic.
